name: Machine Poltergeist
body:
Having no body, you gain the ability to steal mechanical ones.

Prerequisite(s): Incorporeal subtype, Intelligence 15

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to possess a machine or robot that can maintain an AI, much in the way certain spirits possess fleshy targets. This functions as the coded incarnation power, save that your body becomes the AI inside the device. You may leave the device as a standard action, recreating your normal form in a space adjacent to the machine.
